overview: The Medford School Committee approved a solar power purchase agreement and adopted a policy on generative artificial intelligence. The committee also reviewed community feedback on school overcrowding solutions and received updates on the high school building project.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: The committee voted to enter executive session to discuss a collective bargaining grievance with the Medford Teachers Association.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: The committee approved routine business, including bills, payrolls, capital purchases, donations, grants, field trips, and past meeting minutes.

items.title: Mustang Moment: Roberts Rampage Newspaper
items.summary: Students and staff from the Roberts Elementary School presented their newly established student-run newspaper, "The Roberts Rampage."

items.title: McGlynn and Andrews Solar Projects
items.summary: The committee approved a power purchase agreement for solar installations at the McGlynn School and supported exploring expansions to other upcoming school roof projects.

items.title: Space Utilization and Overcrowding Update
items.summary: Superintendent Galusi presented findings from a community survey regarding proposed middle school reconfiguration models to address elementary overcrowding.

items.title: Medford High School Building Project Update
items.summary: Member Graham provided an update on the design process for the high school building project, including the schedule for educational visioning and community advisory teams.

items.title: Policy on Generative AI in Schools
items.summary: The committee approved the second reading of a policy regulating the use of generative artificial intelligence in Medford Public Schools.

items.title: Condolences and Announcements
items.summary: The committee expressed condolences to the families of retired teacher Anna M. Frontavene and Janice Rumley-Ahearn before adjourning.
